# netactuate_cloud_pools (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Pools visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_pools" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cloud_pools` (List of Object) List of cloud pools available to the authenticated account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_pools))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
